items.comments: Shannon's place was great! Adorable and quiet. The lake is right across the street and it's very beautiful. Only slight hiccup was there didn't seem to be wifi provided. But overall still a great experience!
The Basement accomadations were very nice, clean and private with a ton of room. The neighborhood was very charming and we really enjoyed the lake.
Great stay in a basement apartment, loved the location on the Lake. Bed was comfortable and the bar with stools was great for pizza and take-out.
